title: JSW Infrastructure port data feed, v1.0
description: One JSON document per port, describing its operations at one moment. Send a fresh document at least every 5 minutes. General rules: all times are ISO 8601 with the +05:30 offset (or the port's own UTC offset overseas), e.g. 2026-10-16T17:05:00+05:30. All quantities are plain numbers (not text), in metric tonnes (MT) unless the field name says TEU, boxes or moves. Use null for a value you do not have; never "", "-" or 0 in place of unknown. Send totals and quantities done, not balances; the dashboard works out balances and percentages. IDs (berth_id, vessel_id) must stay the same from one document to the next. The financial year runs April to March; months are calendar months on your operational days (see port.op_day_start).

schema_version.description: Version of this format. Always "1.0" for now.

generated_at.description: When the numbers in this document were computed at the port.

source_system.description: Name of the system the data comes from (e.g. PORTMAN, SAP, the terminal operating system). For our records only.

code.description: Port code agreed with the CEPDA team, e.g. JPL, SWPL, MCTL.

name.description: Port or terminal name as it should appear on the dashboard.

type.description: bulk: dry / break-bulk import-export. container: container terminal. Decides which optional fields below apply.

op_day_start.description: Local time your operational day starts, e.g. "06:00". Today, yesterday and month figures must follow this day.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the port, e.g. Asia/Kolkata or Asia/Dubai.

throughput.description: Cargo handled, per period. Bulk ports fill the MT fields; container ports fill the TEU fields and, if available, the MT fields too.

today.description: The current operational day so far.

month.description: Current calendar month so far, with the month target.

previous_month.description: Last calendar month, complete, with its target. Use your official month-end figure (e.g. the MIS / monthly performance report) once it is finalised, and say so in finalised.

finalised.description: true once this is the official month-end figure; false while it can still change.

financial_year.description: Current financial year (April to date), with the full-year target.

berths.description: Every berth, including free ones, in your usual order. berth_id must match the berth layout JSON made with the CEPDA berth layout editor.

berth_name.description: Name as shown at the port, e.g. "Berth 1".

status.description: UNAVAILABLE for maintenance, dredging or similar.

vessels.description: Vessels alongside this berth now; empty when free. More than one only when vessels are double-banked.

waiting.description: Vessels not yet alongside: at anchorage, or expected (call registered, not yet arrived).

vessel_id.description: Your call / VCN number. Must stay the same when the vessel later berths.

cargo.description: Cargo name as you record it.

delays.description: Delays logged in the current operational day, one row per delay reason (per berth / vessel if you track it that way). Optional.

reason.description: e.g. Rain, Equipment breakdown, Awaiting cargo.

yard.description: Container ports only, optional: yard occupancy now.

cargo_group.description: The cargo class used across all ports so the dashboard can compare them. Map your own cargo names onto these; keep your own name in cargo.

total_mt.description: Tonnes handled in the period, import + export. Container ports: null if not tracked.

by_cargo.description: Tonnes by cargo class; should add up to total_mt.

teu.description: Container ports: TEU handled in the period (all moves below added up).

teu_split.description: Container ports: TEU by direction and laden/empty.

boxes.description: Container ports: number of containers (boxes) handled.

vessels_sailed.description: Vessels that completed and sailed in the period.

target_mt.description: Target for the whole period in MT (budget, or revised outlook if one is set). null if none.

target_teu.description: Container ports: target for the whole period in TEU.

vessel_id.description: Your call / VCN number. Stable while the vessel is at the port.

status.description: WAITING: alongside, cargo work not started. WORKING: loading/discharging. COMPLETED: cargo work done, not yet sailed.

status_text.description: Your own status wording, shown as-is (e.g. "Under discharge", "Awaiting documents").

bank_position.description: Alongside, double-banked or triple-banked. null for a single vessel.

expected_completion_at.description: Your estimate of when cargo work will finish.

quantity_total_mt.description: Bulk: total to load/discharge for this call.

quantity_done_mt.description: Bulk: handled so far for this call.

teu_total.description: Container: TEU to handle this call (discharge + load).

moves_per_hr.description: Container: gross berth productivity, moves per hour.
